item.title: Family auction business celebrates 50 years after pandemic pivot brings new life
item.description: Some businesses are lucky to last a few years. But one Utah company is celebrating 50 years and three generations of turning other people's stuff into someone else's treasure.

item.title: Report: Utah Mammoth Acquire Veteran Defenseman From Calgary Flames
item.description: The Utah Mammoth have made their first trade ahead of Friday's deadline as they plan to acquire right-handed veteran defenseman MacKenzie Weegar from the Calgary Flames.

item.title: BYU decides to admit 9 students who received mistaken acceptance notices
item.description: Nine prospective students who were mistakenly told they were admitted to Brigham Young University will be allowed to enroll there after all.

item.title: State revokes license of company following carbon monoxide poisoning deaths of 3 men
item.description: Utah health officials on Wednesday revoked the day treatment license of Safe and Sound Services after three people died of carbon monoxide poisoning.

item.title: Richins trial: Boyfriend testifies about text messages, relationship after Eric Richins’ death
item.description: Robert Josh Grossman, Kouri Richins' boyfriend in the months before and after her husband's death, testified about messages and conversations they shared during her jury trial on Wednesday.

item.title: Shorthanded Sixers Top Utah Jazz In Philadelphia
item.description: Keyonte George battled play for play with 76ers All-Star Tyrese Maxey, but the Utah Jazz came up on the short end of a 106-102 loss.

item.title: Pedestrian in critical condition after being hit by truck in Kearns
item.description: A pedestrian was hit by truck in Kearns on Wednesday night, and hospitalized in what police said was critical condition.

item.title: Utah Jazz Finding Unexpected Spark From Bench Scorer
item.description: The Utah Jazz dropped their seventh straight game, falling on the road to the Philadelphia 76ers 106-102.

item.title: Wayne County residents told to shelter in place, multliple agencies looking for white Subaru Outback
item.description: The Wayne County Sheriff's Office advised all residents to "take extra precautions, keep lights on, keep doors locked, and remain home or with others" on Wednesday evening.

item.title: Former BYU Tailback Signs Deal With Green Bay Packers
item.description: Former Cougar running back Chris Brooks is staying in Green Bay after signing a $4.85 million deal with the Packers.
